question: What fruits does an eleven-faced rudrākṣa bestow upon its wearer?
premises: The eleven-faced rudrākṣa is identified as Rudra
It is described as giving fruits
Those fruits come from various sacrifices
inference: An eleven-faced rudrākṣa, as Rudra, bestows the fruits of various sacrifices.
plain_english: The eleven-faced rudrākṣa is Rudra, the giver of the fruits of various sacrifices.
